name: framenew-instagram-clone-new
description: FrameNew — Modern 2026 MERN / Full-Stack Visual Social & Creator Platform with runtime guardrails, licensing hygiene, and end-to-end verification.
author: Sahil Deshpande

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:licenses && npm test && npm run build
